name: MolmoAct2 Official YAM Placement Alignment
description: Fix the MolmoSpaces MolmoAct2-YAM route so task, scene placement, robot/camera semantics, and rollout video align with MolmoAct2-BimanualYAM official expectations instead of an unseen custom room/countertop task.

userStories.title: Audit official MolmoAct2 YAM placement
userStories.description: As a reproduction maintainer, I want a source-grounded audit of the official MolmoAct2-BimanualYAM task, scene/object placement, instruction, robot state, and camera semantics so that later changes do not invent an unseen task.
acceptanceCriteria: Inspect official MolmoAct2 source under artifacts/molmospaces/molmoact2_yam_integration_analysis_20260620_142443/molmoact2, especially sim_eval/tasks/yam_tasks/bimanual_put_everything_in_box.py and sim_eval/robots/bimanual_yam.py.

Inspect current MolmoSpaces route files including molmo_spaces/data_generation/config/molmoact2_official_yam_box_config.py, molmo_spaces/configs/camera_configs.py, molmo_spaces/policy/learned_policy/molmoact2_yam_policy.py, and scripts/datagen/run_pipeline.py.
Write artifacts/molmospaces/molmoact2_yam_integration/official_alignment_audit_20260623.md listing exact official task/instruction/object/camera/placement evidence and current mismatches.
Do not modify behavior files in this story except the audit artifact.
Do not use or recommend custom room/countertop/frontfix placement unless clearly labeled non-official diagnostic.
userStories.notes: Focus on source-grounded official placement/view semantics; avoid aesthetic changes.

userStories.title: Patch route to official-style task only
userStories.description: As a reproduction maintainer, I want the executable MolmoSpaces route to use the closest available official MolmoAct2 YAM task/placement/camera semantics, not a scene or instruction MolmoAct2 did not see.
acceptanceCriteria: Patch only the minimal route files needed to align MolmoAct2OfficialYamBoxDataGenConfig with the official audit.
Remove or bypass the room/countertop/frontfix custom scene for this official run if the audit shows it is not part of MolmoAct2 official YAM distribution.
Preserve official instruction 'put everything into the box' and objects obj_073-a_lego_duplo, obj_056_tennis_ball, and open_box unless official source proves otherwise.
Preserve official camera names top_cam, left_cam, right_cam and official-like resolution/HFOV/camera orientation semantics; do not invent a new viewpoint to make the video look better.
If exact official ManiSkill/SAPIEN placement cannot be represented in MolmoSpaces/MuJoCo, document the approximation and blocker explicitly in the report instead of hiding it.
Run py_compile on every changed Python file.
userStories.notes: Default route should be source-aligned official task, not visual-room variant.

userStories.title: Run official-aligned rollout video
userStories.description: As Kunyu, I want a fresh rollout video from the corrected official-aligned route so I can visually judge whether the scene/task is now appropriate and whether behavior emerges.
acceptanceCriteria: Ensure MolmoAct2 /act server on 127.0.0.1:8202 is reachable or start/reuse the documented local server only if already available in the environment.

Run a bounded official-aligned rollout with scripts/datagen/run_pipeline.py using MolmoAct2OfficialYamBoxDataGenConfig, robot bimanual_yam, policy molmoact2_yam, and a horizon long enough to inspect behavior, default 300-400 steps if runtime/storage allow.
Save H5, top_cam/left_cam/right_cam MP4s, and a combined/contact-sheet or three-camera MP4 under artifacts/molmospaces/molmoact2_yam_integration/ with a unique 20260623 run name.
Run or update the analysis script to report approach/contact/grasp/lift/place flags and success/reward metrics; label failures honestly.
Write a concise final report artifact containing: official alignment evidence, exact changed files, command run, video paths, behavior evidence matrix, and blockers/next gate.
Do not call the result a successful reproduction unless the official success metric or clear task behavior supports it.
userStories.notes: The deliverable is a video plus honest evidence report, not an overclaim.
